findings.quote: [round 52: no current leg records a skipped count — enumerated and executed only] (round 52: no leg skips — host-gated branches run sandboxed;
findings.class: false statement (absolute no-skips claim contradicted by leg 2's own recorded skip-cases and by this page's own suite table at the same commit)
findings.skill_statement: The parenthetical asserts, of the ten ledger legs, that 'no leg skips' because 'host-gated branches run sandboxed'. At C5 leg 2 (`bash-surface-census`, pinned fecee874) is dispatched at tools/mutate-and-run.sh:1464-1467 with the bare suite `bash "$MUTANT" --selftest` — no sandbox — and the sweep executes every suite as `timeout "$TIMEOUT_S" bash -c "$SUITE"` (:465), inheriting the caller's environment; only legs 7-10 (:1489-1508) wrap their suites in `exec env -i PATH=... HOME=$h/home TMPDIR=$h/tmp ...` (:1491, :1496, :1501, :1506). The pinned target's selftest skips two of its sixteen cases when the handler is absent: JANITOR defaults to `the-janitor` (:83), and :815-823 print `skip-case %02d %-34s substrate-absent (handler not on PATH)` without executing the verbs block. This host has no `the-janitor` on PATH (`command -v the-janitor` -> exit 1), and running the exact pinned bytes as the leg runs them (`bash <blob> --selftest`, sha256 275d8294...53009f) printed `skip-case 15 verbs-sandboxed substrate-absent (handler not on PATH)`, `skip-case 16 verbs-break-injection substrate-absent (handler not on PATH)`, then `SELFTEST: PASS (16 cases)`, rc 0, with 14 `ok-case` lines. So the clause is false in both halves: a leg does skip, and the gate that skips is not sandboxed (it is neither excluded nor run). The page states the same fact elsewhere at C5 — SKILL.md:425 'abstention | ... | 2/16 `skip-case ... substrate-absent (handler not on PATH)` — inside the count' and :440-442 'Abstention is structural in the bash selftest. 2/16 cases print `skip-case ... substrate-absent` and still sit inside `PASS (16 cases)`; the hermetic case set is 14 + 2 substrate-gated that performed no execution' — and the leg's own record, corpus/knowledge/mutation-case-kagi-census.md at C5, carries :27-35 ('Control output confirms `skip-case 15` / `skip-case 16`'; 'the hermetic case set here is 14, plus 2 substrate-gated cases that performed no execution'), :266 (abstention row `2/16 skip`) and :269-270 ('two verb cases are host-gated (14 executions +2 skips on the recorded host)'). What does hold is the narrower reading the round-52 wave-3 review validated (T52W3RevApplied4): the runner's report vocabulary has no skip field (:78-79, emitted at :581/:585), so no runner receipt records a skip and no mutant is skipped (all ten defects run). The sentence as written is stronger than that and does not hold; the next sentence's requirement (':963-964 Host-gated branches must be excluded/controlled or explicitly named') is itself satisfied by leg 2's `skip-case` naming.
